title: Agent call headers v1
description: The x-* headers on every agent LLM call (D1), validated as the strings sent on the wire. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so readers lowercase them before validating. Other HTTP headers are not part of this object.

x-run-id.description: Identifies one agent task; every call of the task carries the same value.

x-step.description: 1-based index of this call within the run, as a decimal string without leading zeros.

x-expected-steps.description: Number of calls this task type usually needs, from recorded runs (D1), as a decimal string without leading zeros.

x-parallel-group.description: Shared by calls of the same run that are sent in parallel; absent for sequential calls.
